name: product-hero
description: Square product hero on seamless white with a reserved lower-right lockup area
semantic: Background is seamless white edge to edge - no floor plane, wall, horizon or studio sweep
Zero text, letters, numbers, watermarks, labels or signage anywhere in the frame
No logo or badge drawn on any surface of the product
No people, hands, vehicles, tools or scale figures
Subject is horizontally centred and fully inside the frame
Lower-right corner area is empty white, reserved for a logo added later by code
